title: Model Procurement Decision Framework: Negotiation Scripts & SLA Sensitivity Tests
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Problem: Enterprise customers evaluating Dedicated and Private deployments repeatedly ask for concrete negotiation levers (discount schedules, capacity commitments, SLA tiers) and want a way to quantify the tradeoff between price and latency/availability objectives. We currently have ad hoc guidance in deals and sales playbooks. Goal: Produce a repeatable decision framework and a set of negotiation scripts that the GTM and Solutions teams can use to evaluate vendor/model procurement and to negotiate contracts with measurable SLA sensitivity testing. Scope: - Focus on model procurement (hosted vs dedicated vs private) for enterprise customers with >$50k/month commitments. - Include price tiers, reserved GPU commitments, burst capacity language, quantization/variant fallback allowances, and SLO/credit structures. - Build an SLA sensitivity matrix mapping latency and availability targets to expected cost per 1M tokens and to implementation risk. Deliverables: 1) Decision framework doc (Confluence) with example scoring sheet 2) Negotiation script templates (email + contract clauses) 3) SLA sensitivity workbook (CSV + interactive Looker dashboard) 4) Implementation runbook for Solutions + Sales to perform a field probe with a pilot customer Acceptance criteria: - Confluence doc with step-by-step scoring sheet and at least three example supplier scenarios - Negotiation scripts include tiered discount schedules and explicit fallback/rollback clauses - SLA sensitivity workbook simulates at least 5 latency/availability scenarios and outputs cost + customer-impact score - Pilot runbook validated by Solutions and Legal - Training session scheduled for Sales and Solutions and recorded for internal knowledge base
acceptance_criteria: Confluence decision framework published with scoring sheet and example scenarios
Three negotiation script templates (email, term-sheet language, and clause snippets)
SLA sensitivity workbook uploaded to shared Drive and hooked to Looker dashboard
Pilot runbook signed off by Legal and Solutions
Training session scheduled and recording added to knowledge repository
